newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from NexGen Music's official demo page, demo terms and current release pages. NexGen seeks unreleased Bass Music, Drum & Bass, Dubstep, EDM, House/UK Garage, Downtempo, Chill-out, Trip-Hop and other styles; rejects material previously offered as a free download and commercial-artist remixes or mashups. The route asks for at least four tracks, minimum 320kbps quality with 16/24-bit WAV or AIFF preferred, a real name, artist name, website or profile and background information. Email submissions may use attachments or Dropbox/WeTransfer-type download links, but streaming-only links are rejected. The official uploader is capped at 300MB. The terms require age 18+, ownership or licensing of all rights, no uncleared third-party samples and grant NexGen a non-exclusive, royalty-free, sublicensable worldwide licence to use, modify, display, perform, reproduce, communicate and distribute submitted files on or through the website. demos@nexgenmusicgroup.com is the designated submission mailbox; info@nexgen.music and info@nexgenmusicgroup.com are general/legal contacts. Official releases dated 2026-06-19 and 2026-07-03 confirm current activity. No upload, attachment, link, email or submission was made.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-18 from KPEO's official music-submission, programming, schedule, station-info and underwriting pages. KPEO says it accepts all genres but no explicit lyrics, and asks for a fully embedded MP3 plus cover art for each single. All visible fields are required: name, email, phone, audio file and image file. Audio may be up to 50MB and artwork up to 20MB. The form displays an 'I'm not a robot' spam-protection checkbox, which was not completed or bypassed. The page asks artists to like KPEO's Facebook and Instagram pages so the station may tag them, but it is not clear whether this is a mandatory eligibility condition. Current programming includes a weekly independent-reggae show covering roots, dub, dancehall and global artists; a world-music show; a multi-genre show spanning Afrobeat and electronic dance; and recurring independent-music programming. KPEO lists worldwide coverage, current on-air and recently-played surfaces, and © 2026. info@kpeo.org is first-party published as a general contact, not the canonical music-submission route. No field, upload, CAPTCHA, social action or submission was performed.
